show.description: The Ultimate Return is a high-octane power drama where a man written off as a loser is revealed as Leo—the unseen kingmaker controlling billion-dollar empires. As ruthless heirs, corrupt elites, and broken relationships collide, love, ambition, and revenge play out in a brutal succession battle where power bows only to truth and courage.
